title: CAISO: batteries and the evening peak
subtitle: Mean by hour of the day, 2026-10-03 to 2026-10-09; battery output below zero is charging

facts: CAISO, 2026-10-03 to 2026-10-09: mean demand peaked in the hour starting 17:00 Pacific at 42823.0 MW, when batteries delivered a mean 5838.73 MW; batteries delivered the most in the hour starting 18:00, 10009.49 MW, and charged hardest in the hour starting 09:00, -10242.27 MW.
Mean battery output 17:00 to 21:00 Pacific, 2026-10-04 to 2026-10-10: 7335.93 MW.
